known_defects: A tracked file reaches the fingerprint only through git's status and diffs, so a change that git does not report leaves the four hashes the same: other line endings in a file that is modified already, with `core.autocrlf=true`; a change of the same size in text that a clean filter drops; or an edit to a file marked with `git update-index --assume-unchanged` (corrected in 0.6.2).

mechanisms.mechanism: A link in an untracked folder is left out whenever an ignore pattern matches it, also a negated pattern: one that starts with `!` and takes the path out of the ignored ones. Git does not ignore such a link, so the reviewer could change it. On Windows the link is a junction, which git reads as a folder: for one that leads to an empty folder git lists no file, this function is the only place that records it, and a change to it leaves the fingerprint the same. On other systems git lists a link as a file, and it is recorded whatever this function says.
mechanisms.trigger: On Windows: ignore rules `pkg/*/` and `!pkg/keep/`, and an untracked junction `pkg/keep` to an empty folder that is pointed at another folder between the two fingerprints.
mechanisms.why_severity: A probable gap on one system, which needs a negated ignore rule and a junction under it.
